policy: Keep all 485 ordered original IDs and 970 frozen Linux/Windows baseline states. Previous closure cases retain their historical scope; current lifecycle cases attach separately only after actual receipts. No member/group promotion from source inspection, suite or symbol presence.
currentEveryDeclaredInputClaim: not established; do not infer a complete pass count

remaining: Runtime enumeration proves member presence/access kind, not its effect or every permitted argument.
Per-member input/result/error/phase/lifetime oracle remains unassigned except for separately identified direct cases.
Source/bridge locations and related suite links do not prove downstream authoritative effect.
Detached snapshots, stale handles, script faults, pause/catch-up and scene/region transitions require member-specific evidence.
Static declarations/examples and native operation coverage are separate denominators; typed examples do not execute every member.
Group labels overlap; passing a related subsystem suite does not certify the group or every constituent mechanism.
Explicit execution-to-effect trace, independent physical/state oracle and discriminating negative control are required for each new closure claim.
Supported combinations, shape pairs, ordering, authority, bounds, malformed data and lifetime cases remain incomplete.
Cold and steady performance measurements are only valid for their exact workload, source, cadence and platform.

authoring.appliesTo: 34 authored component rows; separate source inventory includes 324 control locations and 22 tool sources
remaining: Presence in Scene/editor/serializer is not proof of every authored field, gesture, picker, batch edit, prefab override or dependency path.
Normal edit/save/reopen/undo/cook/export/runtime effect must be traced for an explicitly selected field/route.
Failure, cancellation, source-revision races, private staging, last-good output and cross-scene/shared-asset dependencies remain bounded rather than universally proved.
Manual editor interaction, desktop capture and practical usability are not established by offscreen screenshots.
Family/source listing is not proof of all extensions, malformed content, readiness, jobs, cancellation, reimport or dependency closure.
Exact supported owned/private/read-only content and normal publish/install/export paths require specific receipts.
Native moved-package startup must identify assets/source hashes and unavailable development roots; it does not certify all assets.
Curated-mod admission excludes unsupported payload families; those exclusions are limits, not promised features to implement here.

platformAndHumanGaps: Linux scoped receipts do not promote unexecuted Windows members. Native Windows VM functional results do not establish physical GPU, controller, audio, OS focus or human acceptance.
M67 deferred authoring review, M74 motion/retargeting, M76 workflow and M77 physical motion remain independently pending; no new human acceptance is inferred here.
Lastlight/Wayfarer flight/boarding and ordinary consumer scenarios retain their own pending or historical status.
Original missing briefs remain requirement gaps; later implementation guides are not substitute specifications.
closureUpdateMeaning: previousClosureCaseIds navigate the unchanged historical closure index; lifecycleCaseIds navigate the new LIFECYCLE_CASES.json. Neither alters copied baseline states or certifies every input in a row.
